text: Seabrook Town launches a rapid counter-attack from near the halfway line on their own half. Elias Haddad sends a long pass toward Callum Varga on the left flank near the opponent’s penalty area. Varga crosses immediately to Tomas Kowalski positioned closer to the right side of the six-yard box. Kowalski plays a short pass to Kian Romano, who is just 1.8 metres from the goal at Harbour City’s end. Romano strikes the ball with his foot into the net, giving Seabrook Town a 4-2 lead in the final moments of the match [#1901] [#1902] [#1903] [#1904] [#1906].
